title: Claude root session resumed after a host restart gets no Engram MCP server or ENGRAM_* env, though its project is Engram-enabled (Mac, fit_friends)
acceptance: After state reload, the first human Send or queue Resume that creates a Claude runtime for a previously started local root in a declared, enabled Engram project restores the same external Claude session and supplies the Engram MCP descriptor and the root's scoped ENGRAM_HOME, ENGRAM_ACTOR_ID, ENGRAM_ACTOR_CONTEXT (when available), and ENGRAM_SESSION_ID. A behavior regression demonstrates this from persisted state with no prewarmed declaration cache, through human promotion and the launch boundary.

If eligibility for an otherwise enabled local Claude root cannot be determined at launch, the operator sees the reason and what restores access, with no fallback to another project or inherited Engram identity. Deliberately disabled or undeclared projects continue without Engram.

completion.summary: Restored scoped Engram MCP on explicit cold-launch Send and queue Resume for persisted local Claude root sessions, with the original Claude resume identity. Declaration access failures retain the same prompt and give the operator a recovery reason. The fix is on origin/master in exact Batch 6 commit fa9539220882d6126da63bb542c657786b1400c3.
